{{Quote|I hunger. We trade. I eat.|Jo'dath|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Jo'dath''', also known as '''Jo'dath the Exile''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who lived in the dangerous region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] known as the [[Outlaw's Den]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. An exile, Jo'dath made camp in the northern reaches of the canyon area, and spoke of a "she" that supposedly "needed him." He often traded goods for food, but sometimes grew angry at outsiders and demanded that they leave "her" alone.

==Behind the scenes==
Jo'dath appears as a Black Market vendor in the Outlaw's Den, an open-world PvP zone on Tatooine in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
